goal: Improve defensible CF4-informed z=0 density/velocity recovery before IC inversion. Ultimately LG-only 0.3 cMpc/h, surroundings 1-2 cMpc/h. This experiment remains N32, dx=12 cMpc/h.
reason: Z8 confused posterior uncertainty with spatial density amplitude and white-field/log-posterior probes with physical density. Those conclusions are withdrawn. The existing count link is already nonlinear and matched its mock generator. Test a specified model error with a matched null control; do not presume this explains Z6/Z7 recovery.

data.contract: Reuse native non-calibration PM truth 0 and fixed Z6 covariance trained on 1,2,3,4. Previously inspected development truth, not a virgin test universe. Separate seeded Poisson train(.8 lambda) and heldout(.2 lambda) realizations; each baseline/extension pair gets exactly identical data. Same Z6 synthetic radial velocities in all four fits. Six populations use published count/tracer priors and fixed selection; they are not a volume-complete CF4 galaxy-count catalog.
data.independence_limit: Heldout noise is independent conditional on the same truth and specified intensity. Shared observation machinery is intentional for a controlled link test; no independent galaxy-formation or selection-systematics validation.

model.link: tracer_p proportional to exp(b_p log(rho) + gamma * (log(rho)-mean(log(rho)))^2), normalized per population to model expectation
model.curvature: One common gamma across populations, gamma=0.2*q with q~N(0,1); baseline fixes gamma=0. All original 24 nuisance priors remain free and unchanged.
model.scope: A toy nested tracer-link stress test, not a measured bias law. No stochastic residual field or physical prior change.

sampler.initialization: zero plus .5 standardized jitter, no truth initializer

required: baseline and gamma=0 extended predictions agree; mass and gradients tested
same-data pair identity and heldout separation
all nuisance coordinates including curvature enter convergence diagnostics
heldout pointwise log-predictive comparison, total and six populations
density correlation/RMSE/coverage, posterior-mean spatial SD, individual-draw spatial SD and pointwise uncertainty separately
compare both injected-curvature and matched-null pairs; inconclusive or adverse results are acceptable outcomes
assessment.interpretation: Mechanics pass is not scientific success. A promising extension needs better perturbed-case heldout prediction with density recovery/coverage considered jointly and no material null-control degradation. One truth and one chosen perturbation cannot establish population realism, significances, calibration or production readiness. No forced power matching or selection of the best seed.
assessment.stop: Four fits and one aggregate only; report failures without promotion. No next bundle without user approval.
